question: Are the L0 temporal conclusions robust to the registered monthly source-calendar uncertainty, and how large is the already registered fixed-Legacy timescale uncertainty?
calendar_contract: all scenarios retain identical Reach-year source and crop mass
each scenario receives an independent pre-1961 equilibrium under its own 1961-1970 calendar
EARLY and LATE independently refit the same seven global parameters in every T1/T2/T3 fold
CENTRAL remains the production forcing regardless of sensitivity outcome
robustness_gate: EARLY and LATE must each be P1-noninferior to CENTRAL with paired station-block CI95 upper < 0.005 and no delivery/readout boundary
fixed_timescale_contract: Reuse locked Stage 29 L0/LEG10/LEG20/LEG50 results; no refit, interpolation, k expansion or structure reselection is allowed.
interpretation: Calendar scenarios represent uncertainty in effective monthly N availability, not observed fertilizer dates. Fixed Legacy candidates are structural sensitivity, not identified residence-time distributions.
forbidden: new data or new calendar scenarios
new k_L values or selecting Legacy from P2
temperature, WWTP, SAS, hydrology refit or another N state
